{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for the sentinel values in revenue
print("Revenue values with 999999.99:")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now, filter out the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Also filter out refunded orders (they don't contribute to revenue)
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now, calculate the mean age, excluding -1 as missing
mean_age = df_clean[df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age"}
